name: augur
description: Augur — build/deploy platform composing spaces (design system + prototypes repos) into a static site with an overlay worker.

scripts.deploy:realtime: set -a && . ./.env.deploy && set +a && npx wrangler deploy realtime/src/index.js -c "${REALTIME_CONFIG:?set it in .env.deploy — path to the realtime.wrangler.toml in your deploy shell (see realtime/wrangler.example.toml)}"
